name: model-advisor
description: Picks model and effort for each Claude Code request from 8 profiles (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable): adjusts effort on its own, asks only before switching to a stronger model, logs every decision. In English and Italian

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the mod's questions and of the classifier's instructions. With auto it follows the language Claude Code is set to: Italian if that is Italian, English otherwise.

context.title: Your work and tools
context.description: Optional. A few lines about the work you do and the tools you use, given to the classifier with every request so it weighs your requests better, for example: I edit video in Resolve and deploy on Railway; a final render is production work. At most 1,000 characters.
